evidence.discovery_title: iFixit tears down Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, finds mixed repairability results
evidence.raw_lead: Concluding iFixit’s teardown sequence for Apple’s September launches, iFixit today published the teardown of the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.
evidence.title: iFixit tears down Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, finds mixed repairability results - 9to5Mac

units.text: Concluding iFixit’s teardown sequence for Apple’s September launches, iFixit today published the teardown of the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. Here’s what they found.
iFixit tears down Apple Watch Ultra 4
After applying heat to the new Apple Watch Ultra 4’s screen, iFixit’s Shahram Mokhtari uses the company’s new metal pick to pry the screen open, exposing the battery and the Taptic Engine.

He notes that replacing the 2.444 Wh battery (versus 2.313 Wh in the Ultra 3) still requires removing the screen, which remains a significant repairability drawback. The four screws on the bottom of the case provide access only to the sensor assembly on the underside of the back cover and the S11 chip on the case itself.

Once the screen is unglued, though, removing the battery and disconnecting the display’s press connector seems straightforward enough, provided that the initial step was done carefully enough to avoid slicing through any of the flex cables underneath.
That said, with no significant improvements in repairability, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 scored 4/10 on iFixit’s repairability scale, the same as its predecessor.
iFixit tears down Apple Watch Series 12

iFixit’s teardown of the new Apple Watch Series 12 revealed a slight repairability improvement, with Apple adding stretch-release adhesive and a pull tab that make the 1.461 Wh battery (versus 1.403 Wh in the 46mm Series 11) easier to remove.

Still, as with the Apple Watch Ultra 4, the Series 12 also requires prying off the glued display to get inside, which remains the biggest obstacle to repairs. Mokhtari noted that the tolerances around the Series 12’s display are even tighter than on the Ultra 4, requiring enough force to make him concerned about potentially damaging the screen.
Mokhtari also noted that Apple replaced the ZIF connector and tape used for the display on previous models with a simpler press connector.
The tradeoff is that replacing the screen now also requires removing and replacing the battery, “which, if you’ve come this far, why wouldn’t you?” he adds.
All in all, the modest repairability improvements were enough for iFixit to give the Series 12 a 4/10 repairability score, a 1-point bump from the last base-model Apple Watch it scored.

For comparison, iFixit gave Google’s Pixel Watch 5 a 9/10 repairability score, noting that its display can be removed with just two Torx screws and a gasket, while its battery can also be removed without dealing with adhesive.

units.text: A teardown of the Apple Watch Series 12 reveals two repair-friendly changes, but the same can't be said for the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and its internals.

With the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra, Apple introduced a revamped health sensing system, better battery life, and a more powerful S11 chip. Design-wise, however, the two models are effectively the same as their predecessors, inside and out.
It's safe to say that Apple used tried-and-true designs, at the expense of potential repairability improvements.

According to an iFixit teardown, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 "didn't receive a single meaningful repairability upgrade." While sensor-related components can be accessed by removing screws on the back of the device, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 still needs to be opened screen-first for a battery replacement.

The same is true for the Apple Watch Series 12, though Apple did include two minor enhancements with this model. The Apple Watch Series 12 battery is held in place with stretch adhesive, while the battery in the preceding Apple Watch Series 11 needed to be removed with a pry tool.

Additionally, the Apple Watch Series 12 features a new display connector. Instead of the usual ZIF connector found on prior models, the Apple Watch Series 12 features a press connector underneath a bracket.

While the repair-friendly enhancements in the Apple Watch Series 12 are a welcome upgrade, they're not exactly groundbreaking. Apple arguably could have done more, especially with the Apple Watch Ultra 4, but it's possible we won't see design changes for years.

units.text: Apple has announced that it is now accepting apps that have been updated for the iPhone Duo, though this still means going through mercurial App Store review.

Users will probably have to race to get an iPhone Duo order in when pre-orders start, but developers have a different target date. They are trying to get their apps onto the App Store for October 23, 2026, the day that the iPhone Duo arrives in buyers' hands.

Eventually all apps will surely be modified and updated to take advantage of the new iPhone's folding screen, but there is a benefit to being there first. There may never again be quite as much attention on iPhone Duo apps as there is on day one.

So it's significant that Apple has now informed developers that they can submit their updated or new apps to App Store review. App Store review is not always the fastest, and it's not always the best, but it is the process all developers have to go through.

Specifically, Apple is now telling developers that they can recompile their apps in Xcode 27.1, "which adds development support for iPhone Duo." Then they are able to use that app's Device Hub to see how their work will look on the new device.
After that, if a developer is submitting a new version for the iPhone Duo, they are required to update their screenshots and app preview specifications.

Significantly, though, this announcement includes one detail that hasn't been specified before. Apple says that starting "April 2027, any apps or games submitted will need to include screenshots for iPhone Duo."

Note that while October 23 is the day the iPhone Duo will be in stores and shipping to buyers, pre-orders begin on October 16. And now Apple has also announced that there is a kind of pre-pre-order facility that will be available from October 12.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，苹果公司昨日发布 iOS 27.2 Beta 3 开发者测试版后，今天更新推出 iOS 27.2 第 2 个公开测试版，主要以完善功能、提高稳定性为主。
IT之家查询公开资料，暂未查询到第 2 个公开测试版相关内容，以下是第一个公测版主要内容：
Siri AI 增加五种语言：新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持；此前 iOS 27 中主要只有英语。
FaceTime 支持群组双镜头：群组 FaceTime 可同时使用前置和后置摄像头，既能拍到自己，也能展示身边环境或其他人。参与通话的设备需要运行 iOS 27 或更高版本。
健康 App 重新设计：
新增「洞察」页面，汇总睡眠、活动等日常健康数据；
新增「长寿」页面，结合 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 数据进行趋势分析；
提供健康年龄、柔韧性及听力等评估；
部分评估可通过摄像头分析动作。
调整 Apple Podcasts 界面：首页增加「新集数」和「继续播放」两个区域，更容易找到未收听或尚未听完的节目。
Apple TV App 增加个人资料：可以为家庭成员或儿童建立独立 profile，避免观看记录和推荐内容混在一起。
Apple TV 支持 Multiview：在支持的体育内容中，最多可同时观看四个直播画面。
系统代码还显示 Apple 可能在开发名为 AutoLock 的防抢夺功能：如果 iPhone 检测到手机可能被突然从手中抢走，或长时间处于解锁状态，可能自动锁定。不过这项功能在当前测试版中还不是可直接使用的设置，最终是否随 iOS 27.2 正式发布仍不确定。
目前没有证据显示第二个公开测试版带来大规模的界面变化；相较于首个 iOS 27.2 测试版，新增的用户可见功能有限，重点是进一步打磨健康 App、Siri 多语言和 FaceTime。另外，测试版可能出现耗电、发热、应用崩溃或兼容性问题，不建议安装在主要工作机上。

Spotted by @madeby_ldt on X late on Monday, and confirmed shortly after by leaker @aaronp613 in iOS 27.2, macOS 27.2 beta 3 has an updated Apple Music logo. The change adjusts the word "Music" to use a much thicker font, as well making the entire word lower case.
iOS 27.2 beta 3 uses the new Apple Music logo https://t.co/Y2OaON5Bg3
— Aaron (@aaronp613) October 5, 2026
The overall effect also makes the logo wider overall due to the change in font and font weight.
The change is one that isn't entirely unexpected. After all, even major companies like to shake up their branding efforts to keep up with a modern audience.
For Apple Music, which trades itself as a trendy music streaming service to a young audience, it has more reason to change than other elements of the Apple empire.

While it has surfaced in the beta, the new logo has already cropped up elsewhere. In promoting the Apple Music Hall in London, the updated logo appears alongside the old version in a video trailer for the venue.
As for when the logo will roll out fully, a good opportunity could be the expected upcoming special event on October 13.

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple plans to announce its earnings for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 2, according to the company's updated Investor Relations page . The earnings report will be available at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time on November 2, with new Apple CEO John Ternus and CFO Kevan Parekh to discuss the results during a 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time phone call. Apple will stream the call on its website. Apple's Q4 2026 earnings will cover launch-week iPhone 18 Pro sales. Apple also released the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4 , and AirPods 5 during the quarter. The iPhone Duo won't be included because the quarter covers the period between June 28 and September 26, and the device won't launch until October 23. Apple executives could comment on memory pricing and supply constraints, as well as share holiday quarter expectations. During Apple's Q3 2026 call, Parekh said total company revenue would grow 9 to 11 percent year-over-year in the September quarter. Apple expects iPhone revenue to be affected by foreign exchange headwinds and supply constraints, with growth in the mid-teens year-over-year. Q4 2025 revenue was $102.5 billion, so Apple's guidance suggests $111.7 to $113.7 billion for Q4 2026. units.text: Apple to Report Q4 2026 Earnings on November 2
Apple plans to announce its earnings for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 2, according to the company's updated Investor Relations page.

The earnings report will be available at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time on November 2, with new Apple CEO John Ternus and CFO Kevan Parekh to discuss the results during a 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time phone call. Apple will stream the call on its website.

Apple's Q4 2026 earnings will cover launch-week iPhone 18 Pro sales. Apple also released the Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 during the quarter. The iPhone Duo won't be included because the quarter covers the period between June 28 and September 26, and the device won't launch until October 23.
Apple executives could comment on memory pricing and supply constraints, as well as share holiday quarter expectations.

During Apple's Q3 2026 call, Parekh said total company revenue would grow 9 to 11 percent year-over-year in the September quarter. Apple expects iPhone revenue to be affected by foreign exchange headwinds and supply constraints, with growth in the mid-teens year-over-year.
Q4 2025 revenue was $102.5 billion, so Apple's guidance suggests $111.7 to $113.7 billion for Q4 2026.

units.text: Raspberry Pi为普通PC和Mac推出新版Raspberry Pi Desktop，这是该系统四年来首次重大更新。新版以Debian 13“Trixie”为基础，转为64位amd64架构，并加入Raspberry Pi Connect客户端，让用户可通过该服务对运行此桌面系统的电脑进行屏幕共享或远程终端操作。
新版桌面带来Raspberry Pi近期加入的控制中心和应用程序停靠栏等界面变化，目标是在非树莓派电脑上提供与树莓派相近的桌面体验。它以可启动的Debian ISO镜像发布，用户可将镜像写入USB盘后直接启动，也能选择“持久化”模式，把更改保存到USB盘；如要安装到电脑硬盘或固态硬盘，则可通过系统内置的Calamares安装程序完成。
这款PC和Mac版系统上一次更新仍停留在2022年发布的Debian 11 Bullseye。Raspberry Pi团队解释，过去工程师忙于其他项目，加上公司主要通过销售树莓派电脑获利、操作系统本身免费，因此难以持续投入资源维护PC版；不过用户一直在询问更新，团队称每周仍会收到两三封相关邮件。
新版不再支持32位PC系统，主要是因为Debian已停止提供面向PC的32位系统安装支持。Raspberry Pi表示，近15年内推出的大多数PC以及多数英特尔处理器Mac都能运行64位版本；搭载苹果自研M系列芯片的Mac则暂不兼容，因为Debian对Apple Silicon的支持仍处于实验阶段。

units.text: It’s almost a year since Apple was found to have infringed a Masimo patent for low-power pulse oximeter features used in the Apple Watch.
At the time, the company was ordered to pay $634 million in damages, but a federal judge has now ordered it to pay an additional $184 million in interest …

Apple had been fighting with health tech company Masimo on a couple of fronts. The more serious of them was an International Trade Commission ruling that Apple must remove the blood oxygen feature in two Apple Watch models back in 2023 in order to allow them to be sold in the US. The Cupertino company was forced to redesign the way the feature worked in order to be allowed to bring the devices into the US.

But the company also faced a lawsuit from Masimo, seeking damages for the use of its patented approach to measuring blood oxygen in a power-efficient way. Apple was found to have infringed on this patent and ordered to pay damages amounting to the license fees it should have paid.
Bloomberg Law reports that Apple has now been ordered to pay an additional £184 million in interest on this sum.

Judge James V. Selna rejected Apple’s argument that awarding interest would constitute a windfall for Masimo, citing US Supreme Court guidance that “interest from the time that the royalty payments would have been received merely serves to make the patent owner whole.”

There was some good news for Apple. Masimo had asked for interest calculated at 7%, but the judge rejected this, saying that the interest rate should instead be equivalent to that paid on Massimo’s own borrowing. However, annual compounding still added a total of $184M to the amount due.

units.text: 随着首款折叠屏iPhone Duo即将正式上市，苹果已经向开发者开放经过优化的应用和游戏提交渠道。开发者现在可以将针对iPhone Duo进行适配的应用提交至App Store审核，希望能够赶在新机10月23日上市当天完成上线。
苹果此前已经发布了支持iPhone Duo开发的Xcode 27.1。开发者可以使用Xcode 27.1重新编译现有应用，或者基于这一版本开发全新的应用。苹果还在Xcode中提供了Device Hub工具，可以让开发者模拟iPhone Duo在不同折叠状态、方向以及屏幕形态下的运行效果，从而提前检查应用界面是否能够正确适配。
对于普通应用而言，实际上并不意味着必须重新开发才能在iPhone Duo上运行。现有App Store应用仍然可以在这款折叠屏iPhone上运行。不过，如果应用没有针对iPhone Duo进行优化，那么在展开后的内部大屏上可能无法充分利用全部显示区域，而是以带有黑色边框的形式运行。
采用iOS 27.1 SDK或者更新版本重新构建的应用，则可以根据iPhone Duo的屏幕尺寸动态调整界面，从而充分利用展开后的大尺寸内部屏幕。
因此，开发者现在面临的主要问题并不是“应用能不能运行”，而是能否在iPhone Duo上市之前，让自己的应用拥有真正针对折叠屏优化的体验。
苹果已经为开发者提供了新的App Store产品页面截图和应用预览规格。针对iPhone Duo优化的应用，在提交之后还需要更新相关截图和预览素材，以便向用户展示应用在新设备上的实际运行效果。
如果开发者使用Xcode 27.1重新编译应用并完成适配，App Store中的产品页面还会显示相应的iPhone Duo优化标识。用户可以通过这一标识判断某款应用是否已经针对苹果首款折叠屏iPhone进行优化。
对于开发者而言，最大的压力来自时间。
iPhone Duo将于10月23日正式上市，而预购则从10月16日开始。苹果此次开放应用提交的时间已经非常接近产品正式发售，因此开发者必须尽快完成测试、重新编译、制作截图并提交App Store审核。
而App Store审核本身需要时间，开发者无法完全控制审核速度。如果应用因为某些原因被拒绝，还需要修改后重新提交。因此，现在开始提交的开发团队实际上是在与苹果审核流程赛跑。
不过，越早完成适配也意味着越大的曝光机会。iPhone Duo上市初期将成为苹果生态中的全新设备形态，用户以及媒体都会高度关注哪些应用已经针对折叠屏进行优化。如果某款应用能够在首发当天就提供完整的折叠屏体验，很可能获得比普通应用更高的关注度。
苹果也已经明确了一个长期时间节点。自2027年4月开始，所有提交至App Store的应用和游戏都必须包含iPhone Duo对应的截图。
这意味着目前属于“提前适配”的阶段，开发者可以选择是否立即提交针对iPhone Duo优化的版本。但到了2027年4月之后，iPhone Duo相关截图将成为App Store提交要求的一部分。
从这一时间安排来看，苹果并没有要求所有开发者必须在iPhone Duo上市之前完成完整适配，而是给予了几个月的过渡时间，让开发者逐步调整应用。
对于大型应用而言，iPhone Duo的适配可能不仅仅是简单调整界面比例。折叠屏在完全展开、半折以及闭合状态下可能对应不同的交互方式，开发者需要考虑应用在不同屏幕尺寸和姿态下如何重新排列内容。
例如，传统iPhone应用通常围绕单一纵向屏幕设计，而展开后的iPhone Duo可能拥有接近平板电脑的显示面积。这意味着导航栏、内容区域、双栏布局以及媒体显示方式都可能需要重新设计。
苹果此次提供Device Hub，也说明公司希望开发者在应用正式提交之前充分测试这些不同状态，而不是等到设备上市之后才发现界面存在问题。
iPhone Duo作为苹果首次进入折叠屏手机市场的产品，其应用生态能否在上市初期形成完整体验，将直接影响用户对这款设备的第一印象。苹果显然希望在硬件上市时，就已经有足够多的主流应用能够充分利用内部大屏，而不是出现“硬件已经折叠起来了，软件却还是普通iPhone应用”的尴尬情况。
目前距离10月23日上市已经非常接近，接下来两周将成为开发者适配iPhone Duo的关键窗口。对于希望在首发日抢占用户注意力的开发者来说，现在提交应用已经不是提前布局，而是进入了最后冲刺阶段。

在本次电话会议上，苹果现任首席执行官约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）主持活动、首席财务官凯文 · 帕雷克（Kevan Parekh）将会出席本次活动。这是特努斯从蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）手中接过 CEO 职位后，首次以首席执行官身份参与财报发布。此次亮相标志着苹果正式进入特努斯时代。
在 2026 年第三季度财报发布时，苹果曾给出第四季度营收预期。当时分析师预测 Q4 营收将增长 12.1%，而苹果官方预期为同比增长 9% 至 11%。
产品层面，iPhone 收入预计增长 15% 左右，服务业务增长幅度与第三季度相近。第四季度通常是苹果产品发布的重要时段，但 9 月初发布的新品仅能贡献数周销售额，完整影响需至第一财季才能体现。

units.text: Starting November 5, Apple Arcade subscribers will get access to Crossy Road Rush, a new arcade island adventure with solo and four-player multiplayer racing modes. Watch the trailer for the new game below.
Crossy Road Rush coming November 5

Apple Arcade and Hipster Whale made a joint announcement today, confirming that the new Crossy Road Rush title will be launched exclusively on Apple’s gaming subscription platform starting November 5.

The game follows the classic Crossy Road and Crossy Road Castle aesthetic, with its colorful voxel-style characters and environments, but adds a more adventure-focused structure with combat, exploration, and multiplayer.
Here’s how Crossy Road’s YouTube channel describes the new Apple Arcade-exclusive title:

Swerve, spin, smash and survive an arcade island adventure with the Crossy Road Crew. Chase away an angry Octoboss from peaceful Crossy Cove, free your friends, and restore the island vibes! Ride solo, or connect locally and online with up to 4 players!
The game is scheduled to launch at 4:00 p.m. PST on November 5, but Apple Arcade subscribers can pre-order it now here.
Today’s announcement comes just days after Apple Arcade added five new titles earlier this month: Pusheen’s Place, River City Survivors, Terraria+, Touchgrind BMX 2+, and 4 Pics 1 Word+.
Watch the trailer for Crossy Road Rush below:
Pre-order Crossy Road Rush on Apple Arcade
Apple Arcade is available as a standalone service for $6.99/month or included in the Apple One bundle. It includes access to over 200 games with no ads or in-app purchases.
Do you have a favorite Apple Arcade game? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: Apple will announce the results of its fiscal third quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 2. Here’s what to expect.
Price increases likely to play major role
Apple confirmed today that it will report its Q4 2026 earnings on Monday, November 29.

Following the release of its quarterly results, the company will host a conference call at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET, where John Ternus is expected to participate for the first time as Apple’s new CEO, alongside Apple CFO Kevan Parekh.

For its fiscal Q4 last year, Apple reported $102.47 billion in revenue, up 8%, and $27.47 billion in profit, a whopping 87% increase compared to a $14.7 billion profit in Q4 2024, as a result of a one-time $10.2 billion tax charge related to Apple’s long-running tax dispute in Ireland.

During last quarter’s earnings, Apple said it expected revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 to grow between 9% and 11% year over year, despite an expected 2.5 percentage-point foreign exchange headwind and significantly greater supply constraints affecting the iPhone, Mac, and iPad.

If that pans out, Apple’s revenue should come in between $111.69 billion and $113.74 billion. Apple also guided for a gross margin between 47% and 48%, down from 50.1% last quarter, although that figure included a roughly two-percentage-point benefit from tariff refunds.
In practical terms, Apple’s quarterly results will offer the first full-quarter look at the impact of the sweeping price increases it introduced across much of its hardware lineup in late June.

It is also worth noting that, since the reporting period for this fiscal quarter ended in late September, the results are unlikely to provide a meaningful indication of demand for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, which also received price increases, as the new models only went on sale on September 18.

That said, Apple’s results will reveal how the company weathered another quarter of memory shortages and rising component costs, clearing the way for Ternus’s first full fiscal quarter as CEO to be reported in late January.

units.text: 苹果可能在10月下旬再公布一批新品，并猜测新Mac会成为焦点。多名知情人士称，苹果计划在10月最后一周发布更多产品；他们并未确认这会是一场线下发布会、线上活动，还是通过新闻稿分批公布。AppleInsider将其称为“第二场活动”，属于对发布形式的推测，并非苹果已宣布的安排。
这将接续预计于10月13日举行的智能家居产品发布。彭博社记者马克·古尔曼称，苹果计划在当天推出带屏幕的智能家居中枢、新款HomePod mini和Apple TV 4K，并称苹果将举行一场活动。上述安排目前同样尚未由苹果正式公布。
至于10月下旬可能亮相的Mac，较有可能包括搭载M6芯片的24英寸iMac、采用基础款M6芯片的14英寸MacBook Pro，以及传闻中的OLED触控MacBook Pro高端机型。9to5Mac此前报道称，入门级14英寸MacBook Pro和iMac预计升级M6；OLED触控机型则可能采用M5 Pro或M5 Max，属于不同产品线。
苹果还已公布搭载M5 Ultra芯片、配备512GB统一内存的高配Mac Studio将于10月下旬上市，但这项安排不必然意味着会纳入一场发布活动。OLED版iPad mini也被传今年推出，不过发布时间尚不明确。
因此，目前较稳妥的说法是，苹果可能在10月分两批公布产品，第二批时间落在月底，Mac新品最受关注；具体机型、发布日期和发布形式仍未确定。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 7 日消息，据英为财情 10 月 6 日报道，苹果董事会执行主席蒂姆 · 库克于 10 月 2 日出售了总价约 6,380 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 4.28 亿元人民币）的公司普通股。
本次出售价格区间为每股 331.44 美元至 333.94 美元（现汇率约合 2,225 元至 2,241 元人民币），临近其 52 周高点 345.34 美元（现汇率约合 2,318 元人民币）。
此次出售股票源于 10 月 1 日到期交割的 374,541 股限制性股票单位（RSU），这些 RSU 已转换为等量普通股。苹果公司随后扣留了 199,038 股股票，按每股 $330.32 计算，价值约 $65,746,232，用于支付 RSU 归属所产生的税款预扣需求。
10 月 2 日的股票出售依据库克于 5 月 28 日制定的 10b5-1 规则交易计划执行。此外，库克还于 10 月 2 日以赠予方式处置了 26,325 股股票。完成上述交易后，库克通过其信托持有的苹果普通股数量为 3,237,843 股。

10 月 2 日的股票出售依据库克于 5 月 28 日制定的 10b5-1 规则交易计划执行。此外，库克还于 10 月 2 日以赠予方式处置了 26,325 股股票。完成上述交易后，库克通过其信托持有的苹果普通股数量为 3,237,843 股。
